summary.text: Brandy Donaghy is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 44-Position 1, where she has served since December 2021, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is a Navy veteran and Vice Chair of the House Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brandy Donaghy served in the U.S. Navy, where she worked on aviation weapons and weapon systems on F/A-18 and A-6 aircraft.
She earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Washington Bothell and has worked in real estate, IT and other fields.
Ballotpedia also lists work as an art docent with the Everett School District.
Donaghy took office in the House on December 15, 2021, succeeding John Lovick.
The House Democrats' biography lists her as Vice Chair of the Transportation Committee and a member of the Education Committee and the Consumer Protection and Business Committee.
She is a community educator, organizer and volunteer, serves as a trustee at her church, and is CERT certified in emergency preparedness.
